description: Verify that DHCPREQUEST in RENEWING does NOT carry Option 54 (server identifier) (RFC 2131 §4.3.6 table 5)
approach:
[Objective]
In RENEWING the destination IP is already the server-id (per CONSTRUCTING_MESSAGES_02). Carrying Option 54 inside the message body would duplicate that information and conflict with table 5 in §4.3.6, which lists Option 54 as MUST NOT in renewing/rebinding.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING → renew DHCPREQUEST.
   • options blob does NOT contain Option 54   ← key check

[Pass condition]
No Option 54 inside the RENEWING REQUEST options blob.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing OR Fail_renewing_request_carries_server_id — REQUEST illegally carries Option 54.

verdicts.Pass: RENEWING REQUEST has no Option 54 — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_renewing_request_carries_server_id: DUT renewing REQUEST illegally carries server-id
